zh-CN.title: 翻译作为制度
zh-CN.subtitle: 从个人语言能力到城市中的知识生产
zh-CN.shortSummary: 翻译不只是把词语换成另一种语言，也需要场所、人员、版本、审校和权力关系共同支撑。
curatorialDescription: 玄奘与义净的条目可以让观众看到，译经旅行如何进入长安的寺院、宫廷和知识制度。
这个概念是策展分析工具，不把所有翻译实践都压成同一种制度模型。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要将译场、参与者、底本、译经目录和具体段落逐项连到可核查来源。

en.title: Translation as institution
en.subtitle: From individual language ability to urban knowledge production
en.shortSummary: Translation is not only the exchange of words; it depends on sites, people, versions, review and relations of power.
curatorialDescription: The Xuanzang and Yijing records show how pilgrimage and translation entered the monasteries, court and knowledge institutions of Chang'an.
This is a curatorial analytic tool, not a claim that every translation practice followed one institutional model.
en.researchNote: Translation bureaux, participants, base texts, catalogues and passages still need item-level links to verifiable sources.
